intro.title: FUNDA — Global HTTP Error Banner
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Global HTTP Error Banner — a persistent top-of-page notification that automatically appears whenever any HTTP request in the application fails, displays the error type and a retry action, and dismisses itself or when the next request succeeds. The functional interceptor catches all HTTP errors, classifies them by status code (401, 403, 404, 500), and pushes them to a shared ErrorStateService. The banner component subscribes to this service via the async pipe.
intro.usecase: A centralised HTTP interceptor that classifies and broadcasts errors is the professional pattern used in production SaaS products, banking applications, and enterprise dashboards.
